# Quarantined flaky Iceberg-on-Gluten tests.
#
# These tests fail NON-DETERMINISTICALLY under Gluten/Velox: the same build
# passes them on one CI run and fails them on the next. They therefore cannot
# live in a known-failures baseline -- baselining them turns the gate red on
# every run where they PASS (fail-on-fixed), while leaving them out turns it red
# on every run where they FAIL. The Iceberg Spark UT (Gluten) gate treats a
# quarantined test as NEUTRAL: it never counts as a regression when it fails,
# nor as now-passing when it passes, and it is excluded from the regenerated
# baseline.
#
# Shared by both Spark targets (flakiness is rarely version specific); the
# known-failures baselines are per target.
#
# Format: <class-glob>#<exact test name>. The CLASS part is an fnmatch glob so a
# single line can cover a family of generated variants (e.g. `*TestMergeOnRead*`
# = every merge-on-read variant); the TEST name is matched exactly. Lines
# starting with '#' are comments. Note that Iceberg's JUnit 5 parameterized
# tests carry their parameters in the test name (e.g.
# `testFoo(String)[1]`), so an entry must reproduce the name exactly as the
# JUnit XML reports it.
#
# Prefer fixing the underlying bug and REMOVING the entry over growing this
# list. Every entry should reference a tracking issue for the root cause.
#
# NOTE: when a bug surfaces on a DIFFERENT test each run (so matching by name is
# whack-a-mole), quarantine it by ERROR SIGNATURE in flaky-error-patterns.txt
# instead.
